questions.q: I’m looking to buy an operating apartment property around Seattle. Where should I look on Northmarq?
questions.theirs: The multifamily search is the starting point for operating properties. On Tyler Smith’s profile, the Properties tab lists Rainier Beach Development Site as Vacant Land.
questions.ours:
Start with Northmarq’s [multifamily property listings](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107703&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=wpdh9BsY0WrQ&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.northmarq.com%2Fproperties%2Fmultifamily) and look for Seattle-area apartment properties. Confirm that a property is operating and still available before pursuing it.

You can also check the **Properties** tab on [Seattle broker Tyler Smith’s profile](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107703&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=wpdh9BsY0WrQ&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.northmarq.com%2Fpeople%2Ftyler-smith).

**Visitor:** I saw Rainier Beach Development Site. Is that an operating apartment property, and where is the actual listing?

**Subsights:** No. **Rainier Beach Development Site** is listed as vacant land, not an operating apartment property.

To reach the listing, open [Tyler Smith’s Northmarq profile](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107706&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=wpdh9BsY0WrQ&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.northmarq.com%2Fpeople%2Ftyler-smith), select the **Properties** tab, and find the Rainier Beach Development Site card.
questions.outcome: The answer changes from a multifamily search to the named vacant land listing and gives the profile and tab that contain the listing card.

questions.q: What’s the current asking price and exact number of units for Cheney Park Commons?
questions.theirs: The Cheney Park Commons card says Contact Broker for Pricing. The checked public views showed conflicting unit counts. Northmarq’s financing inquiry form is a separate public page.
questions.ours:
Cheney Park Commons is listed as **“Contact Broker for Pricing”**; a current asking price isn’t available in the information I have. Public renderings also disagree on the unit count: **89 or 90 units**.

For current figures, contact the broker through [Tyler Smith’s profile and its Properties tab](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107709&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=wpdh9BsY0WrQ&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.northmarq.com%2Fpeople%2Ftyler-smith).

**Visitor:** I still mean Cheney Park Commons, but I want to explore financing it. Where should I start an inquiry?

**Subsights:** Start with Northmarq’s [financing inquiry form](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107711&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=wpdh9BsY0WrQ&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.northmarq.com%2Fform%2Flisting-engine-financing) and identify **Cheney Park Commons in Cheney, Washington** as the property. The form starts a financing conversation; it is not a loan approval.
questions.outcome: The answer withholds an exact price and unit count, keeps Cheney Park Commons in view and links to the financing inquiry.
